chunks: His command is decree and wisdom, His pleasure is security and mercy. He decrees with knowledge and forgives with forbearance.
ai.seo_question: What are the characteristics of Allah's command and pleasure according to Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: Attributed to Imam Ali in Nahj al-Balagha, this passage encapsulates the Shia theological understanding of divine justice (Adl) and mercy (Rahma), framing Allah's decree (Qada) not as arbitrary will but as an expression of perfect wisdom (Hikma). It underscores the balance between His authoritative command and His forbearance (Hilm), offering believers a model for trusting in divine providence while seeking spiritual security through His pleasure.

en.sayed-ali-raza: Allāh’s verdict is judicious and full of wisdom. His pleasure implies protection and mercy. He decides with knowledge and forgives with forebearance.
